plugins.name: pfm-app-template
plugins.description: Generate new internal Prop Firm Match apps (React 19 + tRPC, pre-wired with auth, a data layer, the PFM design system, and CI) on Cloudflare Workers (default, Vite SPA) or Vercel (Next.js App Router); pull template updates into apps already generated from it, or migrate an existing ad-hoc internal tool onto the same stack.
